{{Wireless adapter |brand=LG |model=AN-WF100 |revision= |upc=719192578838 |ean= |asin=B003F9HH2W |price= |est_release_date= |fcc_date=12/22/2009 |manuf_country=China |is_manuf=No |manuf=Arcadyan |manuf_model= |manuf_rev= |availability=now |if=USB |if_bus_version=2.0 |if_connector_type=Male A |form_factor=dongle |vendor_id=043e |device_id=3001 |id_string= |fcc_id=BEJ-WF100 |ic_id=2703H-WF100 |chip1_brand=Broadcom |chip1_model=BCM4323 |addl_chips= |accessible_UART=No |flags= |ant_conn=U.FL |802dot11_protocols=abgn |txchains=2 |rxchains=2 |sstreams=2 |oui=00:E0:91,E8:5B:5B |lin_driver= |win_driver= }} {{TagLine|Wi-Fi USB Adapter for LG TV}} :[http://www.lg.com/us/tv-audio-video/accessories/LG-tv-accessories-AN-WF100.jsp Product page] Used with a variety of LG HDTVs. *"P/N:141852220008J" is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos. *"E85B5B…" and "WN8522B 2-LF-19" is silkscreened on the [[:File:AN WF100 LG.jpg|sticker]]. :[[Arcadyan WN8522B]] (FCC ID: RAX-WN8522B) This device has two internal U.FL connectors. {{see also|LG AN-WF500|Arcadyan}} {{WiFiCert|WFA7996|02/04/2010}} === Compatible TV models === 2010-2011 *LED LCD TV: LW6500, LW5700, LW5600, LV5500, :LV5400, LV3700, LE55, LE54, LE7 series *LCD TV: LK550, LD8, LD7, LD6, LD5 series *Plasma TV: PZ950, PZ750, PZ550, PK7, PK9, PX9 series *Projectors: HX350Y, HW300 :For 2014 TVs, please see [[LG AN-WF500]] 
AN-WF100 is a Wi-Fi USB dongle that can only 
be used on any of the following LG TV model:

PDP: 50PK750/950/760/790, 
60PK550/650/750/950 Series 
 
LCD: LA50/LA55/LA60,
LE55/LE70/LE80/LE90/ 
LEX7/LEX8/LEX9 Series
